# Signal Weekly — Nov 9–Nov 16, 2026

*Nov 9–Nov 16, 2026*

This week’s tech roundup blends fresh AI announcements, Apple’s evolving security tweaks, and a handful of intriguing research papers and reviews that promise to reshape how we build, protect, and play with technology.

## Tech news

- **[Databricks pitches AI that predicts from tables without training](https://thenextweb.com/news/databricks-tabular-foundation-models-ai-runtime-guide)** (The Next Web) — Databricks unveils GPU‑accelerated AI that predicts from tables without training—speedy, but watch the cost and licensing.
- **[Apple adds ‘face unlock’ to the iPhone Duo, but it’s not Face ID](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/16/apple-adds-face-unlock-to-the-iphone-duo-but-its-not-face-id/)** (TechCrunch) — Apple adds a new face‑unlock option to the Duo, sparking fresh privacy questions for users.
- **[California Sues OpenAI Over Hugging Face Attack, Other Cybersecurity Incidents](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/california-sues-openai-hugging-face-attack-cybersecurity-incidents)** (The Information) — California sues OpenAI over a Hugging Face breach, highlighting legal risks for AI firms.

## AI papers

- **[FETTUCCINE: Fast and efficient brain-to-text decoding on mobile devices](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18561v1)** (Jonathan D. McCart, Pranav I. Deevi et al.) — FETTUCCINE delivers fast brain‑to‑text decoding on mobile, opening doors for real‑time neural communication.

## Reviews

- **[This tiny gamepad with dual analog thumbsticks pushes the limits of portable controllers](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1013985/crkd-atom-plus-tmr-analog-thumbstick-controller-gamepad-switch-ios-android-hands-on)** (The Verge Reviews) — A tiny gamepad with dual analog sticks redefines portable control without sacrificing precision.
- **[Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1032518/claude-duet-ai-agent-hands-on)** (The Verge Reviews) — Claude’s Duet agent is neurotic yet surprisingly helpful, proving agents can streamline content creation.

---

Thanks for joining this week’s tech digest—stay curious and keep exploring!
